title: David Jent Realty Joins REMAX, Bringing Enhanced Technology, Brand Recognition and Opportunities to Southern Middle Tennessee
summary: Longstanding family-owned brokerage joins the power of the REMAX network to support agents and serve buyers and sellers across Marshall County and beyond
body_markdown:
**LEWISBURG, Tenn. (Sept. 1, 2026) –** After more than four decades of serving Southern Middle Tennessee, David Jent Realty is entering a new chapter. The family-owned brokerage has joined the REMAX network and will now operate as REMAX David Jent Realty, bringing the global brand’s technology, marketing resources, referral network and agent support to its two office locations in Lewisburg and Chapel Hill.


Founded in 1980 by David Jent, the brokerage has built a strong reputation for serving buyers and sellers throughout Marshall County and the surrounding region. Today, Broker/Owner Jason Jent, who purchased the company from his father in 2012, leads the business and its team of 18 agents as it transitions to the REMAX brand.


For him, the move is about positioning the brokerage and its agents for continued growth in a competitive real estate landscape.


“We’ve been serving this community for 46 years, and we’ve built our business on relationships, trust and local expertise,” says Jason Jent. “As the industry continues to evolve, we wanted to align with a brand that offers the technology, support and name recognition to help our agents thrive today and well into the future. REMAX gives us the tools and resources to stay competitive while continuing to deliver the personalized service our clients expect.”


##


Jason Jent, Broker/Owner REMAX David Jent Realty


The transition will provide agents with access to the REMAX global referral network, industry-leading marketing and technology platforms, professional development opportunities and the backing of one of real estate’s most recognized brands.


Jent says the strength of the REMAX name was a major factor in the decision.


“When people relocate to a new area, they often look for a name they recognize and trust,” he says. “That’s the power of REMAX. The brand’s reputation, visibility and network create opportunities for agents and give consumers confidence from the moment they walk through the door.”


Known locally for its family-oriented environment, David Jent Realty has fostered a close-knit culture where agents support one another and focus on putting clients first. Jent plans to carry that same philosophy forward under the REMAX banner.


A second-generation real estate professional, Jason Jent has been licensed since 1998 and is currently in his 28th year in the industry. After years working alongside his father in the business, he assumed ownership of the brokerage in 2012 and has continued its legacy of serving rural communities throughout Southern Middle Tennessee. With the transition to REMAX, Jent sees an opportunity to build on that foundation while expanding the resources available to agents and clients alike.


REMAX David Jent Realty will serve buyers and sellers from its offices at 430 W. Commerce St. in Lewisburg and 4682 Nashville Hwy. in Chapel Hill. For more information, visit remaxdavidjentrealtytn.com or call 931-359-6631 for Lewisburg and 931-364-5678 for Chapel Hill


###


**About REMAX David Jent Realty:**


REMAX David Jent Realty is a locally owned and operated full-service real estate brokerage located in Lewisburg, Tennessee. The brokerage has 18 real estate agents and specializes in residential homes of all types from single family to multi family properties, and Land Lots and Farms REMAX David Jent Realty serves Marshall County. Each office independently owned and operated.
